description: Header file defining internal utilities and classes for testing exception safety in the Abseil C++ library, including exception classes, tracking mechanisms, and test builders.

classes.name: TestException
classes.description: A simple exception class used for testing exception safety.

classes.name: TestBadAllocException
classes.description: A custom exception class derived from std::bad_alloc and TestException for testing allocation failures.

classes.name: TrackedAddress
classes.description: Tracks whether an object is alive and its description for exception safety testing.

classes.name: ConstructorTracker
classes.description: Tracks object constructions and destructions to detect leaks or re-constructs during tests.

classes.name: TrackedObject
classes.description: Base class for objects whose lifecycle is tracked for exception safety testing.

classes.name: ThrowingBool
classes.description: A convertible to bool class that can throw exceptions during conversion.

classes.name: ExceptionSafetyTest
classes.description: Performs exception safety testing on objects of type T using provided factory, operation, and contracts.

classes.name: ExceptionSafetyTestBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for configuring and running exception safety tests with various factories, operations, and contracts.

methods.name: operator|
methods.description: Bitwise OR operator for TypeSpec and AllocSpec enums.

methods.name: operator&
methods.description: Bitwise AND operator for TypeSpec and AllocSpec enums.

methods.name: GetSpecString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of TypeSpec or AllocSpec.

methods.name: FailureMessage
methods.description: Generates a failure message for exception test failures.
